scientific_question: Does reactive astrocyte localization around CA1 pyramidal neurons capture a neuron-adjacent gliosis niche associated with memory decline beyond bulk CA1 neuronal loss and bulk reactive astrocyte enrichment?
approach: Assign cells to CA1 using the annotation polygons, then identify CA1 Pyramidal Neuron, Astrocyte, and Reactive Astrocyte labels from ClassificationNode. For each CA1 pyramidal neuron centroid, test whether at least one CA1 reactive astrocyte lies within radius r, and whether at least one CA1 astrocyte or reactive astrocyte lies within the same radius. The donor biomarker is: (# CA1 pyramidal neurons with at least one reactive astrocyte neighbor within r) / (# CA1 pyramidal neurons with at least one astroglial neighbor within r). This yields a local reactive-over-astroglial neighborhood score centered on pyramidal neurons.

variations.name: ca1_pyr_reactive_niche_r50px
variations.description: Same biomarker using a 50 pixel neighborhood radius, approximately 25 microns.

variations.name: ca1_pyr_reactive_niche_r60px
variations.description: Baseline biomarker using a 60 pixel neighborhood radius, approximately 30 microns.

variations.name: ca1_pyr_reactive_niche_r70px
variations.description: Same biomarker using a 70 pixel neighborhood radius, approximately 35 microns.

notes: Use annotation polygons from CustomAnnotations after dividing polygon coordinates by 16 before region assignment. Restrict both the pyramidal query set and astroglial neighbor set to CA1 cells only. Centroid-based KD-tree or radius-neighbor search is sufficient; no contour geometry is needed. Fixed pixel radii are acceptable because slide MPP is tightly clustered near 0.5 microns per pixel. If the denominator is zero or CA1 pyramidal counts are unexpectedly tiny, return NaN rather than forcing a value.
rationale: Rounds 1 and 2 established that both CA1 pyramidal depletion and CA1 reactive astrocyte enrichment matter, so the next clean step is to localize the astroglial signal rather than introduce a new diffuse summary. A spatial niche feature asks whether reactive astrocytes are specifically concentrated around surviving CA1 pyramidal neurons, which could add signal if neuron-adjacent gliosis is more informative than overall CA1 reactive fraction, or replace the current reactive marker if it is a cleaner formulation of the same biology.
